name: 入力と条件と写真をまとめる画像探索パネル
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
One Lighthouse LH01-0075 入力と条件と写真をまとめる画像探索パネル. Input1 ORIGINAL entire panel is immutable media/control base. Input2 native mock supplies Japanese query, chip and caption copy only; its generic magnifiers over photos and plain filter bars are wrong.
Keep source two-column staggered masonry photo order, all FOUR room photos and decor-chip thumbnail EXACT, same original crops/aspects/rounding. No redraw, enhancement, smoothing, resynthesis, object replacement, altered wall art/TV pixels, room reconstruction or framing change. Preserve fine artwork/furniture/plant/rug textures and colors. Original source crop controls EVERYTHING disputed in glyph geometry.
Top source back chevron slate#526173; white outlined input; Japanese query exactly "くつろげる部屋のアイデア" Meiryo Regular40014/24, source microphone capsule/U/stem/foot at right. Source filter TWO horizontal lines with circular knobs (upper RIGHT/lower LEFT), not three lines, source upper-right state dot adapted from red to forestgreen#1F6444.
Second row four Japanese controls "条件", "提供元", "装飾", "暖かな色": native Japanese arrangement and source decor thumbnail130:126. White neutral outlined chips; first selected green outline/text; any dropdown carets follow original/native control role. No broad mint/pink/orange chip fills or invented counts.
All four result captions Japanese exactly "部屋づくりのアイデア" Regular40012/16, with original horizontal three-dot overflow at right. Over each photo retain ORIGINAL solid diagonal pushpin silhouette in small translucent white rounded-square bottom-right, recolored slate#526173. NOT a magnifier, heart, outline pin or vertical pushpin. Keep exact source pin angle/anatomy.
Purewhite#FFFFFF canvas, compact alignment/gutters, mutedneutral outlines, no extra wrapper, bottomnavigation, title, device or English captions. All supporting text REGULAR, no bold. Static raster only; search/filter/mic/photo/overflow actions unverified. Preserve media pixels; localized text/UI fill edits only.
reviewNotes: Combined Japanese query/chips/captions and diagonal pushpins restored, but protected room/decor photos resynthesized and photo proportions changed. Upper filter outlined knob merged into filled state dot; original has two outlined knobs plus a separate dot. Needs source media fidelity and glyph correction; raster only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
